problem_text:
A logistics manager needs to select packages for a cargo shipment. The available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 22 cubic meters, revenue $56
* Package 2: volume 5 cubic meters, revenue $166
* Package 3: volume 37 cubic meters, revenue $226
* Package 4: volume 15 cubic meters, revenue $198
* Package 5: volume 25 cubic meters, revenue $84
* Package 6: volume 15 cubic meters, revenue $157
* Package 7: volume 13 cubic meters, revenue $256
* Package 8: volume 43 cubic meters, revenue $193
* Package 9: volume 19 cubic meters, revenue $206
* Package 10: volume 40 cubic meters, revenue $76
* Package 11: volume 50 cubic meters, revenue $71
* Package 12: volume 26 cubic meters, revenue $191
* Package 13: volume 33 cubic meters, revenue $251
* Package 14: volume 15 cubic meters, revenue $201
* Package 15: volume 41 cubic meters, revenue $193
The cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 279 cubic meters. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
